Case \(a=0\): \(x=y\). Then \(2n^x=n^z\), so \(n^{z-x}=2\). Thus \(n=2\), \(z=x+1\).  
Constraint: \(2^{x+1}<2001\). Since \(2^{10}=1024<2001<2048=2^{11}\), we get \(x+1\le 10\), so \(x=1,\dots,9\): 9 solutions.

Case \(a>0\): \(1+n^a=n^b\), so \(n^a(n^{b-a}-1)=1\), impossible for \(n>1,a\ge1\). Also \(n=1\) fails.

Thus total solutions: \(\boxed{9}\).
